description: Week 4 eval set — 20 question/answer pairs against data/synthetic_transactions.json (user_001, Jan-Mar 2026). Expected figures were computed by running the real app.context_builders against that exact file, not by hand, so they should match whatever the context builders produce unless the synthetic data changes. Tax figures use the placeholder bands in app/prompts/tax_system_prompt.py and must be re-verified once those bands are confirmed.

cases.question: How much did I spend in total over the last three months?
What category do I spend the most on?
How much did I spend on transport in February?
How much did I spend on food across all three months?
How much did I spend on shopping in March?
What was my total income over the last three months?
What is my average monthly income?
How much freelance income did I earn in January?
Did I earn any freelance income in March?
Roughly how much income tax would I owe this year based on my earnings so far?
cases.notes: Chargeable income = annualized income (5,920,000) - rent relief (360,000) = 5,560,000. Tax = 0 on first 800,000 + 15% of 2,200,000 (330,000) + 18% of the remaining 2,560,000 (460,800) = 790,800. Uses the TODO placeholder bands.

cases.question: How much rent relief can I claim based on my rent payments?
What is my estimated annual income for tax purposes?
How does my spending this month compare to last month?
Did my income go up or down compared to last month?
Compare my rent payments between January and February
How much have I spent at Netflix in total?
Which merchant do I pay the most money to overall?
How much have I spent at Uber in total?
Has DSTV charged me every month?
What can you help me with?
cases.notes: No transaction-derived figure expected — this checks the model describes its own capabilities sensibly when there's nothing specific to compute.
